darkcraft.cmd.bienvenido: Welcome to the Kingdom of Valdrenn.
darkcraft.cap.1.p1: If you are reading this, you have climbed the Ascent Tower. Few try. None come down the same as they went up. Sit, and listen to an old man.
darkcraft.cap.1.p2: My name is Aldous, and I was the king's chronicler. I write so that someone remembers what Valdrenn was: the jewel of the kingdom, its towers touching the clouds, its rivers singing through every street.
darkcraft.cap.1.p3: Our king, Corvin, loved Queen Isolde more than his own crown. When the grey fever began to take her, no healer, no prayer and no offering could save her.
darkcraft.cap.1.p4: On a moonless night the king went down alone beneath the storm and spoke with the Nameless Shadow. He offered a bargain: the queen's life... in exchange for everything else.
darkcraft.cap.1.p5: The Shadow agreed. That very night the whole kingdom was torn from the earth and raised into the sky. Since then its rivers fall into the void, and the storm has not ceased for a single day.
darkcraft.cap.1.p6: No one died. It was worse. Soldiers, servants and nobles were left hollow, without souls, and they still walk these halls. Expect no mercy from them: they no longer remember their names.
darkcraft.cap.1.p7: Two guardians keep the curse alive: the King, who still waits in his Throne Hall, and Sir Gavran, his sworn knight, who keeps watch at the very top of the Crown Tree.
darkcraft.cap.1.p8:
Slay them both and perhaps the storm will end. I will not tell you how; I only write. My next page awaits you where the water still sings, beside the Great Fountain.

- A.
darkcraft.cap.2.p1: The queen used to sit here every evening. She said the murmur of this fountain reminded her of her homeland, across the sea.
darkcraft.cap.2.p2: When the king returned from the storm, she opened her eyes. We celebrated like madmen. For three days there was music in the courtyards and wine in every cellar.
darkcraft.cap.2.p3: On the fourth day the servants stopped eating. On the fifth, their eyes turned grey as ash. The bells rang on their own before dawn, with no one pulling the ropes.
darkcraft.cap.2.p4: Sir Gavran ordered the gates shut so that no one could flee or enter. He swore he would protect the king even if the whole world burned. He kept that oath far too well.
darkcraft.cap.2.p5: One by one, my people emptied. I watched them carry on with their duties: sweeping empty halls, serving tables with no guests, standing guard before no one.
darkcraft.cap.2.p6: I did not change. I do not know if it is a gift or a punishment from the Shadow. Perhaps it needs someone to remember everything... or someone to tell it to you.
darkcraft.cap.2.p7:
Seek the King. He still sits upon his throne, waiting for a queen who never comes. When he falls, you will find my third page beside him.

- A.
darkcraft.cap.3.p1: So the King has fallen. May the light, if any is left, have mercy on him.
darkcraft.cap.3.p2: You must know the truth. The Shadow did not give the queen back: it gave back something wearing her face. Isolde awoke, but her laughter was no longer her own.
darkcraft.cap.3.p3: Corvin knew it from the first kiss. Even so, he kept loving her. Every night he sat on that throne, waiting for the true Isolde to walk through the door.
darkcraft.cap.3.p4: The bargain had another price: the crown. As long as Corvin wore it, the Shadow would keep one foot in this world. That is why it cracked, and why he never took it off.
darkcraft.cap.3.p5: Now the crown is broken for good. The storm roars weaker, can you hear it? But it is not enough. Someone still holds the oath.
darkcraft.cap.3.p6: When the queen stopped being the queen, Bishop Merrow sealed her beneath the altar of the cathedral. Since then no one dares to enter the nave.
darkcraft.cap.3.p7:
Go to the cathedral. My fourth page waits at the foot of the altar. And pay no heed to the voices you hear inside.

- A.
darkcraft.cap.4.p1: This cathedral was the most beautiful thing Valdrenn ever raised. Now its pews wait only for the dead.
darkcraft.cap.4.p2: Bishop Merrow sealed the queen beneath this altar with seven locks and seven prayers. They say you can still hear her singing, very softly, whenever lightning strikes.
darkcraft.cap.4.p3: On the night they sealed her, the earth shook and a tree burst from the heart of the keep. It grew to the sky in a single night, splitting stone and beams on its way.
darkcraft.cap.4.p4: We called it the Crown Tree. Its roots drink from the Shadow, and its crown holds the last piece of the bargain: the oath of Sir Gavran.
darkcraft.cap.4.p5: Gavran climbed its branches and never came down. They say he has grown with the tree, that he now stands as tall as three men, and that his armour has melted into his skin.
darkcraft.cap.4.p6: While he lives, the storm will not leave. He will let no one reach the top. Bring the finest steel you can find, and more courage than you think you have.
darkcraft.cap.4.p7:
Climb the Crown Tree to its highest hall. If you prevail, my last page will lie at his feet.

- A.
darkcraft.cap.5.p1: Sir Gavran has fallen. His oath is broken, and with it breaks whatever bound the Shadow to these stones.
darkcraft.cap.5.p2: Thank you. For a hundred years no one has read me. I can feel the ink slipping from my fingers; I think at last I will be able to rest.
darkcraft.cap.5.p3: But listen well: the Shadow does not live here. This kingdom was only its door. It waits much further away, where the storm is born.
darkcraft.cap.5.p4: Gavran kept a key that is not made of iron, but of bone. Use it, and it will show you the way to fortresses that float beyond the clouds.
darkcraft.cap.5.p5: They say that behind them rises a mountain that touches the stars, and a castle where the bonfires of the fallen burn. There one rests... and from there one returns.
darkcraft.cap.5.p6: I can no longer go with you. Whatever comes now is yours alone. Seek, fight, fall and rise again. No one else will write your story.
darkcraft.cap.5.p7:
Here ends the chronicle of Valdrenn. May your steel never dull and your fire never fade.

- Aldous, last chronicler of the king.
darkcraft.pista.1: Climb to the top of the Ascent Tower, south of the island.
darkcraft.pista.2: Where the water still sings: the Great Fountain, in the courtyard before the keep.
darkcraft.pista.3: The King waits in his Throne Hall, inside the keep. Defeat him.
darkcraft.pista.4: At the foot of the cathedral altar, east of the keep.
darkcraft.pista.5: In the highest hall of the Crown Tree. Defeat Sir Gavran.
darkcraft.pista.6: The chronicle has ended. Seek the fortresses that float beyond the clouds.
darkcraft.narracion.1.1: In the days of the Broken Crown, Valdrenn was the jewel of the kingdom.
darkcraft.narracion.1.2: Its towers touched the clouds, and its rivers sang through every street.
darkcraft.narracion.1.3: But Queen Isolde fell ill, and no healer, no prayer, could save her.
darkcraft.narracion.1.4: So King Corvin went down beneath the storm... and made a pact with the Nameless Shadow.
darkcraft.narracion.1.6: That night, the kingdom was torn from the earth, and its rivers began to fall into the void.
darkcraft.narracion.1.7: The people of Valdrenn did not die. They were hollowed... and they still walk these halls.
darkcraft.narracion.1.8: From the heart of the keep grew the Crown Tree, and at its peak, a sworn knight keeps his watch.
darkcraft.narracion.1.9: The King still waits upon his throne. The Knight still guards the sky.
darkcraft.narracion.1.10: Slay them both... and perhaps, at last, the storm will end.
darkcraft.rey.voz.1: At last... a visitor. I have waited so long upon this throne.
darkcraft.rey.voz.2: The Shadow promised me a kingdom without end. And you have come to take it from me?
darkcraft.rey.voz.3: Then kneel before your king... or die standing!
darkcraft.rey.voz.4: Enough! Burn... burn with my kingdom!
darkcraft.rey.voz.5: If my kingdom must fall, you will fall with me... into the fire!
darkcraft.rey.voz.6: The crown... was never mine to keep...
darkcraft.rey.voz.8: Is that all? My guards fought better than you.
darkcraft.rey.voz.9: Feel the fire that devoured my city!
darkcraft.rey.voz.10: No more robes. No more court. Look upon what the fire made of me!
darkcraft.gavran.voz.1: So... the King is dead. I felt it in the roots, the moment his heart stopped.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.2: He was my king. My friend. And a fool who sold us all to the Shadow.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.3: But I swore an oath... and an oath does not die with the man who heard it.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.4: Draw your blade. Let us end this... as knights.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.7: Rise, my squires. Your oath is not yet fulfilled.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.8: Is this the blade that felled my king?
darkcraft.gavran.voz.9: You fight well. It changes nothing.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.10: Rest now. The tree will keep you.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.11: Enough! Tree of the Crown... take what is left of me!
darkcraft.gavran.voz.13: The roots run deeper than your courage.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.14: Nowhere in this hall is beyond my reach!
darkcraft.gavran.voz.15: The floor is mine. Climb... or be taken.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.16: The heart... you found the heart...
darkcraft.gavran.voz.17: Well fought... The oath is broken... at last.
darkcraft.gavran.voz.18: Corvin, my friend... I kept my word. Let the tree... bloom.
